name: Uruamerica Order Consolidator for WooCommerce
author: Dario Torres

sections.description:
Uruamerica Order Consolidator for WooCommerce solves one of the most common headaches for store owners: having to open every single order one by one to figure out what products you need to prepare for shipping.

Instead of wasting time manually counting items across dozens of orders, this plugin groups all products from your completed orders within a date range and shows you exactly how many units of each product you need to pack — all in one clean, downloadable list.

It’s the picking list tool that WooCommerce is missing out of the box.

Who is this plugin for?

  • Small and medium WooCommerce stores that process orders in batches (daily, weekly, etc.)
  • Fulfillment managers who need a quick product summary before heading to the warehouse
  • Store owners who want to reduce packing errors and save time preparing shipments
  • Dropshippers coordinating with suppliers on what to reorder
  • Any store that sells variable products (sizes, colors, etc.) and needs a clear breakdown by variant

Free version features

  • Select a start and end date range for your consolidation
  • Automatically consolidates orders with Completed status
  • Correctly groups simple and variable products — each variation (size, color, etc.) is listed separately with its own quantity
  • Shows which order numbers contain each product
  • Quick stats: total orders included, distinct products, and total units at a glance
  • Download the consolidation as a TXT file — easy to print, share by email or WhatsApp
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage / custom order tables)
  • Works with both classic post-based orders and the new wc_orders table architecture
  • Clean, modern admin interface built with WordPress best practices

How it works

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Order Consolidation in your WordPress admin
  2. Select a start date and end date
  3. Click Generate Consolidation
  4. See the full product list with quantities needed
  5. Download as TXT or use the list directly on screen

No configuration needed, no complicated setup.

Example use case

You run an online clothing store. Every Monday you prepare all the orders placed over the weekend. Instead of opening 47 orders one by one, you select Friday to Sunday, click Generate, and instantly see:

  • Blue T-shirt Size S — 12 units
  • Blue T-shirt Size M — 8 units
  • Black Hoodie Size L — 5 units
  • White Sneakers Size 42 — 3 units

You hand that list to your warehouse team and they start packing immediately. No errors, no missed items.

Pro version

Upgrade to Uruamerica Order Consolidator Pro for advanced features:

  • ⏰ Filter by exact time — set a start and end time, not just date (perfect for shift-based fulfillment)
  • ☑️ Manual order selection — browse all orders in the date range and cherry-pick which ones to include or exclude using checkboxes
  • 🏷️ Multiple order statuses — include Processing, On Hold, Pending, or any custom status
  • 📊 Export to CSV — open directly in Excel or Google Sheets
  • 📄 Export to PDF — branded, print-ready consolidation report with your store logo
  • 🔗 Direct order links — click any order number to jump directly to that order in WooCommerce
sections.installation:
From the WordPress plugin repository (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Uruamerica Order Consolidator”
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Order Consolidation — no setup required

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Order Consolidation
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin automatically detects whether your store is using WooCommerce’s custom order tables (HPOS) or the classic post-based system, and works correctly with both. HPOS compatibility is fully declared.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes, and this is one of the plugin’s strongest features. Each product variation is tracked and counted separately. If you sell a T-shirt in sizes S, M, L, and XL, the consolidation will show the exact quantity needed for each size — not just a combined total.

Can I filter by order status other than “Completed”?

Filtering by multiple order statuses (Processing, On Hold, Pending, and custom statuses) is available in the Pro version. The free version consolidates Completed orders only.

Can I filter by exact time, not just date?

Yes, but that feature is available in the Pro version. The free version works with full-day ranges (midnight to midnight).

Can I choose which specific orders to include or exclude?

Manual order selection with checkboxes is a Pro version feature. The free version includes all completed orders within the selected date range.

What does the TXT export look like?

The TXT file is a clean, aligned plain text table. It includes a header with consolidation metadata (date range, store name, generation timestamp), the product table with SKU, name, variation, type, and quantity, a totals row, and the list of included order numbers. Designed to be readable when printed or shared as a plain text message.

How many orders can it consolidate at once?

There is no hard limit. However, for stores processing thousands of orders per period, we recommend consolidating over shorter ranges (daily or weekly) to avoid long page load times.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions or other extensions?

Yes. The plugin reads standard WooCommerce order items and works alongside Subscriptions, Bookings, and most other WooCommerce extensions as long as orders are stored in the standard WooCommerce structure.

Does it support WordPress Multisite?

The plugin works on individual sites within a WordPress Multisite network. It does not aggregate orders across multiple sites in the same network.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Date range consolidation for completed WooCommerce orders
  • Support for simple and variable products with full variation breakdown
  • Quick stats: order count, product count, total units
  • TXT export (downloadable picking list)
  • Full HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • Works with both classic post tables and custom order tables
  • CSS and JS loaded via wp_add_inline_style() and wp_add_inline_script()
